item.title: Create Cluster Labels
item.description: This section describes how to create cluster labels. Prerequisites You need to have the Cluster Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Cluster Management permissions. Click Cluster Management. On the Cluster Management page, click the Label Management tab to open the cluster label list. Click Create on the page.

item.title: Edit Cluster Labels
item.description: This section describes how to edit cluster labels. Prerequisites You need to have the Cluster Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Cluster Management permissions. Click Cluster Management. On the Cluster Management page, click the Label Management tab to open the cluster label list. To the right of the label you want to edit, click , and then select Edit from the drop-down list.

item.title: Add Labels to Clusters
item.description: This section describes how to add labels to clusters. Prerequisites You need to have the Cluster Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Cluster Management permissions. Click Cluster Management. On the Cluster Management page, click the Label Management tab to open the cluster label list. To the right of the label you want to add to a cluster, click , then select Add to Cluster from the dropdown list.

item.title: Remove Labels from Clusters
item.description: This section describes how to remove labels from clusters. Prerequisites You need to have the Cluster Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Cluster Management permissions. Click Cluster Management. On the Cluster Management page, click the Label Management tab to open the cluster label list. To the right of the label you want to remove from clusters, click , and then select Remove from Clusters from the drop-down list.

item.title: Delete Cluster Labels
item.description: This section describes how to delete cluster labels. Note If a label has been added to a cluster, it will be removed from the cluster after deletion. Prerequisites You need to have the Cluster Management permission on the KubeSphere platform. Delete a Single Label Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Cluster Management permissions.
